description:
Pages of the current site: list, create, rename/SEO, delete, read and save the source, content text, preview. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- list_pages: List all pages of the site (metadata only, without source)
- create_page: Create a new (empty) page.
- update_page: Update page properties: name, slug, homepage, SEO ("Cài đặt SEO") and settings.
- delete_page: Delete a page
- get_page_source: Get page source overview: section count, element type counts, and all custom CSS classes.
- update_page_source: Directly update the full page source JSON.
- list_page_contents: List multi-language contents (translations) of the site's pages and global sections.
- update_page_content: Create/update page content for a specific language.
- preview_page: LOOK at a saved page before publishing: screenshots of the SAVED (unpublished) draft at desktop and mobile width, through the editor's own Preview host (it renders page.source +…
